name: curved-path
title: Walk along an S-shaped path
instruction: One adult walks along the marked S-shaped path at a natural, self-selected pace: first a bend to the left, then a bend to the right, then straight on. The person is already walking when the clip starts and is still walking when it ends (they do not reach the end of the marked path). The body should turn with the path the way a real walker's does, not slide around the bends.
